payload.gloss: a domain law broken across entities by a merge, although each branch kept it: a reference to a withdrawn entity, a cycle, one name held by two entities, more than one bound plan, or a unit realizing a concept its plan does not. A name is held by every live entity carrying it, by a withdrawn entity that keeps it, and by a diverged entity for every name its heads carry. Reported like divergence.
